_comment: en_gb：只放与 en_us 不同的条目，其余由 Minecraft 自动回退到 en_us（模组语言文件标准做法）。
linkedshield.command.damage.hint: FULL = the shield absorbs everything and loses the same amount; PIERCE = damage passes through by shield percentage; NONE = the shield ignores it. Single type: /linkedshield damage <damage type>
linkedshield.editor.group.shield.note: Settlement happens after armour, enchantments and effects, before absorption — the shield loses exactly the damage that would have reached your health. Pierce ratio = clamp(1 - shield/max, minPierceRatio, 1)
linkedshield.editor.group.damage.note: Damage is classified by damage type and vanilla tags, not by who hit you. FULL = fully absorbed; PIERCE = percentage pierce; NONE = the shield ignores it. Percentages are per cent of the incoming damage.
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.ex: PIERCE by default: exactly the same percentage formula as melee.
linkedshield.editor.ui.vanillaNote: The grey elements are drawn with the vanilla layout, so you can line your shield bar and party panel up against them.
linkedshield.editor.ui.previewHint: Drag to move, scroll to resize: wheel on the party panel = overall scale; wheel on the shield bar = width, Shift+wheel = height. Changes are written straight into the form on the left; click "Save settings.json" to store them.
